IN THE SPECIAL SESSION OF THE MIXED COURT ...

Mr "Y" Cheng appeared for the S.M. Council.

I Proceedings. Mr Cheng :- The representative of the P.S.B., stated at the last hearing, that the accused lived on the top of a paint shop at Fong Yee Shing, Rue Admiral Courbet ( F.C.). The accused denies having lived at this place, the Police however ascertained from the proprietor of the premises, that the accused lived there between October and December last year. The accused stated that he resided at Route Duplex and Rue Batard, but when the Police took the accused to the premises situated on the roads mentioned, the tenants could not identify the accused.

Accused :- The chief tenants of the premises, have removed, consequently at the moment there is no one on the premises that know me. In reply to the Judge :- I do not know Tseu Kung Foo, and Zau Ling.

Representative of the P.S.B. Lau Young Ching :- We have another communist, who voluntary surrendered to the Government, he is present in court and can identify this accused.

Witness, Tsang Yue Ming :- I was formerly a communist. I voluntary surrendered to the Government. I know the accused. He came to my house on several occasions. He was my communist teacher when I was a communist. I knew the accused last year. He went under the name of Wong Siau Zien, alias Lai Wong. He is the writer in the Woo Tsi Wei Communist League. I was the secretary for this league.

Accused :- I do not know this witness.

在混合法院特别庭审中……

“Y” Cheng 先生代表工部局出庭。

诉讼程序。Cheng 先生：- 公安局代表在上次听证会上称，被告住在法租界高乃师路（Rue Admiral Courbet）方裕兴油漆店楼上。被告否认曾住在此处，然而警方从该房产业主处查明，被告去年十月至十二月期间确实住在那里。被告称他住在杜普雷路（Route Duplex）和巴达路（Rue Batard），但当警察带被告前往上述道路所在的房产时，租户无法认出被告。

被告：- 该房产的主要租户已经搬走，因此目前房产内没有人认识我。回答法官提问：- 我不认识周公甫（Tseu Kung Foo，音译）和赵玲（Zau Ling，音译）。

公安局代表刘永清（Lau Young Ching，音译）：- 我们还有另一名向政府自愿投诚的共产党员，他目前在法庭上，可以指认这名被告。

证人，张月明（Tsang Yue Ming，音译）：- 我以前是共产党员。我向政府自愿投诚。我认识被告。他曾几次来我家。当我还是共产党员时，他是我的共产主义导师。我去年认识被告。他使用黄孝先（Wong Siau Zien，音译）的名字，别名赖王（Lai Wong，音译）。他是无产者联盟（Woo Tsi Wei Communist League，音译，可能指“无产阶级联盟”或类似组织）的文员。我是该联盟的秘书。

被告：- 我不认识这位证人。

公安局代表 我申请移交

Daily Report 29. 3. 34.

Communist Propaganda - Result of court proceedings

Tsang Ching Tuh (張敬徒) alias Lau Wong (老王),
a communist suspect, reported to be secretary of the local
Mutual Aid Society, who was arrested by the Municipal
Police on Avenue Edward VII on March 23, 1934, at the
instance of the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau, appeared
on remand before court on March 28 when he was ordered to
be extradited to the Chinese Authorities.
pages.zh:

曾敬徒（Tsang Ching Tuh，此处英文拼写与前文Tseng略有不同，但中文名一致为張敬徒），别名老王（Lau Wong），
一名共产主义嫌疑犯，据报为当地
互助会秘书，于1934年3月23日在爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）
应上海市公安局的要求被工部局警察逮捕，
于3月28日出庭受审，当时被命令
引渡给中国当局。

D.S.Harvey and C.D.S.208 escorted the accused to 118 Doong Ching Li (同德里) off Rue Ratard, French Concession, assistance being rendered by D.S.Gelin, Political Branch, French Police. The 1st tenant and sub-tenants at this address had only resided there for about one month and none of them knew the accused. Detectives then proceeded to 62 Tuh An Li (杜安里) off Route Duplex, French Concession, the accused stating that he formerly resided at this address in a small room on the 2nd floor. The caretaker of the premises denied knowing the accused and the present occupant of the room concerned has resided there continuously for two years, consequently the accused could not have occupied the room since June 1933.

The representative of the P.S.Bureau stated in Court that the accused had formerly resided above the Fong Yu Shing (方裕兴) Paint shop, 135 Route Admiral Courbet, French Concession. The accused was questioned on this point but strenuously denied having resided at this address. Detectives escorted the accused there and he was identified by the owner of the shop named Fong Tsang | |

Judge 26 / 3 / 21

Accused Tseng Chih Tuh ( ) Age 27. Chauffeur.

Charge Application for writ of detention in accordance with Articles
42 & 66 of J.V.P.
Application is made by the C.I.D. on behalf of the Public Safety Bureau, Nantou,
for the detention of the above named accused, who was
arrested at 3.15 p.m. on the 23/3/4, on Mohawk Road near
Avenue Edward VII at the request of an agent in the employ of the
Political Branch, Public Safety Bureau, Nantou, on suspicion
of being a member of the Communist Party.
Witness: Agent Tseu Kwung Foo.

SECOND BRANCH KIANGSU HIGH COURT - Adm.

Proceedings:- Mr. T. Y. Chang appeared for the Shanghai Municipal Council.

Accused:- I reside at No.119 Ching Yuen Li,
off Carter Road, and I am a chauffeur but at present unemployed.

Mr. Chang:- At 3.15 p.m., 23.3.1934, the
accused was arrested on Mohawk Road near Avenue Edward VII by C.I.D.
1642 at the request of an agent of the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau
named Tseu Kwung Foo, who stated that the accused was a suspected
Communist. The accused was taken to the Station and questioned
but he denied being a Communist or having any connections with Com-
munists, and he made this statement (handed to the Judge). The ac-
cused's house is No.119 Ching Yuen Li, off Carter Road, and it was
searched but nothing incriminating was found; nothing, also, was
found in his possession. A telephone message was sent to the
Shanghai Public Safety Bureau and D.I.Kyul Tsang Han came to the
Settlement Police Station and stated that Tseu Kwung Foo was an agent
of the Bureau. Tseu stated that he had seen the accused three days
ago and followed him, and that when he saw him again yesterday he called
the Policeman in order to have the accused arrested. There is no
evidence other than that of the agent, Tseu Kwung Foo, so I ask that
the case be remanded to enable the Police to make further enquiries,
and I also ask the Court to order the Public Safety Bureau to
produce prima-facie evidence at the next hearing.
AND
Accused:- I am a chauffeur/was formerly employ-

            Witness Den Yoong Tsing:- I represent the
Shanghai Public Safety Bureau. The alias of the accused is Lau
Kong. An arrested Communist named Lau Ling produced these papers
(handed to the Judge) which had been passed to him indirectly by the
accused. This is the old address (paper handed to the Judge) of
the accused. (translation of the paper - "top of paint shop, named
Faung Yue Shing, rue Colbert).

            Accused:- I have never lived in the French
Concession, and I did not hand any papers to Lau Ling. (papers shown
to the accused). I have never written such papers and I do not know
any person named Lau Ling.
(accused ordered by the Judge to write certain characters on a sheet
of paper)

            Witness Tseu Kwung Foo:- I am an agent of the
Shanghai Public Safety Bureau. I am an ex-Communist and was detailed
from Nanking after voluntarily surrendering myself. I was formerly
a Communist in the French Concession and I know the accused. The
accused is a writer of the "Foo Tai Wei" of the Communist Party. I
saw him during January, 1934. I had connections with the accused
for six months and I saw him on numerous occasions when meetings
took place. Tsang Ching Tuh is a false name because his proper
name is Wong, although I do not know his other name. I met him recent-
ly and saw him again yesterday and had him arrested.

            Mr. Chang:- The witness stated at the Station
that he first saw the accused six months ago and that the accused
was then a leader of a group of Communists who supplied legal aid, etc.

（左侧手写批注：Mutual Aid Society）

REPORT
Date March 23, 1934.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE File No. REGISTRY. No. D 5755 Date 24/3/34）

Subject (in full) Arrest of a communist suspect by C.P.C. 1642 of Chengtu Road Station at the instigation of the Public Safety Bureau.
Made by D.P.S. Lingard Forwarded by J.B.Ln. S.

At 4 p.m. on March 23, 1934, the undersigned together with C.D.C. 280 and Clerk Liao proceeded to Chengtu Road Station to investigate the case of a male Chinese who had been arrested on Mohawk Rd. at 3.15 p.m. on that day by C.P.C. 1642 of Chengtu Rd. Station at the instigation of a Public Safety Bureau Agent named Tseu Kwen Foo(周坤甫).

A thorough search of the prisoner Tsang Ching Tuh(曾靜德) failed to reveal anything which might be deemed to indicate his being in any way connected with the Communist Party.

The prisoner claimed to be a bona fide resident of 119 Ching Yuen Li(錦遠), Carter Road. This address was visited by a party consisting of D.P.S. Lingard, C.D.C. 280 (Special Branch) and D.S. Harvey and C.D.S. 208 of Chengtu Rd. On reaching the said address, the No.1 tenant recognized the accused and said he had occupied the room over the kitchen for more than a month, and allowed us to enter the premises. The accused led us to his room, where a search failed to reveal anything of communistic nature.

A full statement was taken concerning the activities and antecedents of the prisoner in custody.

The accused is being detained at Chengtu Road Station and will be brought before the Shanghai Special District Court to-morrow morning, March 24, when a Writ of Detention will be applied for.

Inspectors Jui Tsaung Wei(裘壯偉) and Tai Yoong Tsing(戴永清) of the Special Branch of the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau, identified the agent Tseu Kwen Foo.

The case is being conducted by D.S. Harvey of Chengtu Rd. Station in conjunction with Section 2, Special Branch.

Deputy Commissioner, Special Branch.
W.H. Lingard

主题（全称）成都路警局警员 C.P.C. 1642 在公安局唆使下逮捕一名共产党嫌疑犯。
由 D.P.S. Lingard 制作，经 J.B.Ln. S. 转发。

1934 年 3 月 23 日下午 4 时，签署人会同 C.D.C. 280 及廖书记员前往成都路警局，调查一名中国男子被捕一案。该男子于当日下午 3 时 15 分在成都路警局警员 C.P.C. 1642 根据一名名为周坤甫（Tseu Kwen Foo）的公安局特工的唆使下，在莫霍克路（Mohawk Rd.）被捕。

对囚犯曾静德（Tsang Ching Tuh）进行了彻底搜查，未发现任何可被视为表明其与共产党有任何关联的物品。

囚犯声称自己是卡特路锦远里 119 号的合法居民。由 D.P.S. Lingard、C.D.C. 280（特务科）、D.S. Harvey 和成都路警局 C.D.S. 208 组成的小组走访了该地址。到达上述地址后，第一房客认出了被告，并称其已占用厨房上方的房间一个多月，并允许我们进入屋内。被告带我们到了他的房间，搜查未发现任何具有共产主义性质的物品。

就羁押囚犯的活动和背景作了完整笔录。

被告正被拘押在成都路警局，将于明天上午，即 3 月 24 日，被提解至上海特区地方法院，届时将申请拘留令。

上海公安局特务科的督察裘壮伟（Jui Tsaung Wei）和戴永清（Tai Yoong Tsing）指认了特工周坤甫。

本案由成都路警局的 D.S. Harvey 与特务科第二股联合办理。

特务科副总监。

Tsang Chi & Tuh (張敬德)
Shantung                                          D.P.S. Lingard
Chengtu Rd. Stn           23/3/34                 Clerk Liao.

My name is Tsang Ching Tuh, native of Shantung,
age 27, married. I am living at No.119 Ching Yuen
Li, Carter Road. I am by profession a chauffeur, but
at present I am unemployed. I am able to read and write,
having received my education at the Foo Lung School
(扶輪) in Jingyang, Honan, where I started studying
at the age of 8, and continued as a student till
I was 16, when I left school. On leaving school I
obtained work as an apprentice in the Hanyang Arsenal,
Hanyang, Hupeh, where I remained for three years when
I left this place. I then became a mechanic on the
Peiping-Hankow Railway at Chengchow in Honan. I was
employed on this railway for 4 years after which owing
to sickness, I had to hand in my resignation. On the
termination of my employment I returned to Jingyang
my
to/father's home. My father was an overseer in a
FOREST PRESERVE lumber-yard of the Peiping-Hankow Railway in Jingyang.
I remained convalescing at my father's home for 1 year,
and then started to help my father in his business,
and remained as his assistant for about two years.
I left Jingyang and came to Shanghai in June, 1933.
My reason for coming to Shanghai was to look for work.
I reached Shanghai towards the end of June, but cannot
remember the exact date. I travelled all the way by
train. On arriving at the North Station, I went straight
to a small boarding house on Foochow Road to which
I was directed by one of the touts of that establishment.
pages.zh:
曾静德（張敬德）
山东                                          D.P.S. Lingard
成都路警局           34/3/23                 廖书记员。

我叫曾静德，山东籍，
27 岁，已婚。我住在卡特路锦远里 119 号。我的职业是司机，但目前失业。我能读会写，
曾在河南信阳的扶轮学校（Foo Lung School）接受教育，我从 8 岁开始在那里学习，
一直读到 16 岁离校。离校后，
我在湖北汉阳的汉阳兵工厂找到了一份学徒工作，
在那里待了三年后离开。随后，我成为河南郑州
平汉铁路的一名机械师。我在这条铁路上工作了 4 年，之后因病不得不辞职。雇佣关系终止后，我回到信阳
我
父亲的家中。我的父亲是平汉铁路在信阳的一个
森林保护区木材场的监工。
我在父亲家休养了 1 年，
然后开始帮助父亲做生意，
作为他的助手大约两年。
我离开信阳，于 1933 年 6 月来到上海。
我来上海的原因是找工作。
我在 6 月底到达上海，但记不清确切日期。我全程乘火车旅行。到达北站后，我直接
去了福州路的一家小旅馆，是该旅馆的一名拉客者指引我去那里的。
